There is no PDF to commit to docs/ for this device. That absence is the strongest evidence available and it is the finding.

The no-comms conclusion rests on vendor marketing copy plus the absence of any vendor document — not on a protocol document and not on inspection. No teardown, rear-panel photo, or community report of a hidden serial port was found.
